description.en: Rebuilds any 3D model, SVG, or image as particles that scatter around the cursor and spring back into shape.
description.zh: 将任意 3D 模型、SVG 或图片重建为粒子，在光标周围散开后弹回原来的形状。

discovery.caveat: 需准备目标模型、SVG 或图片；渲染器要求见详情。

notice.en: Reference entry. This AI catalog does not redistribute component source. Install directly from the author's registry under its license; the @canvas-ui namespace belongs to the upstream author.
notice.zh: 来源收藏条目。本 AI 目录不重新分发组件源码；如需使用，请遵守作者许可并直接从作者的注册表安装。@canvas-ui 属于上游作者。

description.en: URL of the asset: GLB/glTF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF. Object URLs from a file input work too. The format is detected from the bytes, not the extension. Draco-compressed models are supported via a decoder fetched on demand.
description.zh: 素材 URL：GLB/glTF、SVG、PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF；也支持文件输入生成的 Object URL。根据字节内容识别格式，而非扩展名。按需下载解码器以支持 Draco 压缩模型。

description.en: Number of particles the asset is rebuilt from.
description.zh: 重建素材使用的粒子数量。

description.en: Particle size in CSS pixels at the model's distance.
description.zh: 模型所在距离处的粒子尺寸，单位为 CSS 像素。

description.en: Random per-particle size variation (0 to 1).
description.zh: 每个粒子尺寸的随机差异（0 至 1）。

description.en: Override color as any CSS color. Leave empty to keep the asset's own colors.
description.zh: 覆盖颜色，可使用任意 CSS 颜色；留空保留素材原色。

description.en: Radius of the cursor's push field in CSS pixels.
description.zh: 光标推动场的半径，单位为 CSS 像素。

description.en: How hard the cursor pushes particles away.
description.zh: 光标推开粒子的力度。

description.en: Tangential curl of the push (0 to 2). Particles spiral around the cursor instead of only fleeing it.
description.zh: 推动的切向卷曲强度（0 至 2），使粒子环绕光标旋转。

description.en: How quickly displaced particles spring back home.
description.zh: 位移粒子弹回原位的速度。

description.en: Velocity damping (0 to 1). Lower values keep particles wobbling longer.
description.zh: 速度阻尼（0 至 1），较低值使粒子摆动更久。

description.en: Idle shimmer of the resting particles (0 disables).
description.zh: 静止粒子的闲置闪动强度，0 关闭。

description.en: Background color behind the particles. Leave empty for a transparent canvas.
description.zh: 粒子后方的背景颜色，留空则画布透明。

description.en: Size of the longest side of the asset in scene units. The camera sits about 4 units away.
description.zh: 素材最长边的大小，单位为场景单位；摄像机距离约为 4 个单位。

description.en: Horizontal offset of the asset in scene units.
description.zh: 素材的水平偏移，单位为场景单位。

description.en: Vertical offset of the asset in scene units.
description.zh: 素材的垂直偏移，单位为场景单位。

description.en: Strength of the floating bob animation (0 disables).
description.zh: 上下漂浮动画的强度（0 关闭）。

description.en: Strength of the idle rocking rotation (0 disables).
description.zh: 闲置摇摆旋转的强度（0 关闭）。

description.en: Speed of the float and rocking animation.
description.zh: 漂浮与摇摆动画的速度。

description.en: Let the user orbit the camera by dragging.
description.zh: 允许用户拖动以环绕观察物体。

description.en: Let the user zoom with the scroll wheel or pinch.
description.zh: 允许用户使用滚轮或双指手势缩放。

description.en: Spin the camera around the asset turntable-style.
description.zh: 让摄像机以转台方式环绕素材。

description.en: Turntable speed when autoRotate is on.
description.zh: autoRotate 开启时的转台速度。

description.en: Camera field of view in degrees.
description.zh: 相机视场角，单位为度。

description.en: Camera distance from the center of the asset.
description.zh: 摄像机与素材中心的距离。

description.en: Base URL of the Draco decoder, fetched only when a model needs it.
description.zh: Draco 解码器的基础网址，仅在模型需要时加载。

description.en: Called after an asset finishes loading.
description.zh: 素材加载完成后调用。

description.en: Called when an asset fails to load.
description.zh: 素材加载失败时调用。

description.en: Classes applied to the wrapper element.
description.zh: 应用到包装元素的 CSS 类。

dependencies.frameworkNote: Solid uses solid-js; Preact uses preact. Other framework dependencies follow the target project.

install.behavior: Commands are metadata only. This catalog and CLI never execute installation.

browserNotes: WebGPU builds need a browser with WebGPU; verify the current browser support before choosing a renderer.
HTML-in-Canvas is experimental. Check the component's current upstream browser/fallback documentation. Do not assume DOM capture works in every browser.
